question: What initial elements of the world-measure are introduced for contemplation?
premises: The measure of the worlds will be explained briefly for understanding.
The explanation enables one to pass quickly through the cosmic egg in contemplation.
Within the egg are Ananta, Kāla, Kūṣmāṇḍa and Hāṭaka, and Brahmā and Hari.
inference: The text begins its brief world-measure by listing Ananta, Kāla, Kūṣmāṇḍa, Hāṭaka, Brahmā, and Hari within the cosmic egg.
uncertainties: Kūṣmāṇḍa and Hāṭaka may refer to worlds or regions; the verse names them without explicit category labels.
plain_english: That will now be explained briefly, so that one may quickly pass through it in understanding. Within the cosmic egg are Ananta, Kāla, Kūṣmāṇḍa and Hāṭaka, and Brahmā and Hari.
